questions.stem:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

BEAUTIFUL
questions.explanation: 'Beautiful' means pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically. Its direct opposite (antonym) is 'ugly', which means unpleasant or repulsive in appearance.

questions.stem:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

EXPAND
questions.explanation: 'Expand' means to become or make larger or more extensive. The opposite of expanding is shrinking or making smaller, which is perfectly captured by the word 'contract'. The other options are synonyms.

questions.stem:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

ARROGANT
questions.explanation: 'Arrogant' means having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities. 'Haughty', 'Proud', and 'Conceited' are all synonyms. The direct opposite is 'Humble', which means having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's own importance.

questions.stem:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

TRANSPARENT
questions.explanation: 'Transparent' refers to a material allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen. Its exact physical antonym is 'Opaque', meaning not able to be seen through. 'Clear', 'Lucid', and 'Limpid' are synonyms.

questions.stem:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

OBSTINATE
questions.explanation: 'Obstinate' means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action, despite attempts to persuade one to do so. 'Stubborn', 'Adamant', and 'Resolute' are synonyms. The antonym is 'Flexible', indicating a willingness to change or compromise.

questions.stem:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

EPHEMERAL
questions.explanation: 'Ephemeral' describes something lasting for a very short time. 'Transient', 'Fleeting', and 'Temporary' are all precise synonyms. The direct opposite is 'Permanent', meaning lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely.

questions.stem:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

OBSEQUIOUS
questions.explanation: 'Obsequious' means obedient or attentive to an excessive or servile degree. 'Subservient', 'Sycophantic', and 'Deferential' are synonyms representing submission. The opposite is 'Domineering', meaning asserting one's will over another in an arrogant way.
